caller_asset_contract.notes: Every detector weight, config, calibration, licence, rights record, breath policy, natural event label manifest, cohort manifest, parity vector, runtime lock and output-use grant must exist at an absolute path and match its declared SHA-256 before a caller may process audio. No upstream revision is pinned because the merged evidence records no breath-detector or breath-removal candidate source.

required_geometry.status: exact_input_boundary_only; candidate detection window, lookahead, policy and removal geometry unestablished

exact_blockers.requirement: Supply one exact breath detector/removal source checkout at an immutable 40-hex revision under research/voice-enhancement-20261101/repos/breath-detector-removal or data/checkouts/breath-detector-removal; no such checkout exists in the workspace.

Supply the exact detector/classifier/removal weights, model configuration and calibration with byte counts and SHA-256 values at one immutable revision; no weight was downloaded or identified by digest in the merged evidence.

Record the exact sample rate, channels, frame/hop, detection window, lookahead, content delay, removal gain/attenuation recipe, final-padding rule and breath target/preservation policy in a pinned config; the merged evidence contains no candidate geometry or policy.
Provide an isolated hash-pinned runtime with a complete lock at data/envs/breath-detector-removal/requirements.lock and a recorded platform; no environment, package pin or lock exists.
Add the upstream artifact licence and terms at the resolved commit; no licence file, terms statement or redistribution grant is recorded in the merged evidence or present in the workspace.

Freeze a rights-cleared natural breath event-label manifest with exact source intervals, removable versus preserve labels, speaker/noise strata, known positives and negatives; the merged click screen explicitly leaves natural clicks and breaths untested.

Clear voice/breath recording consent, speaker and training-data rights, source-audio and output-use rights, and redistribution terms, then add the rights record and output-use grant; no consent or rights record exists.

Produce one approved exact-runtime detection/removal output plus a rights-cleared held-out cohort scoring event precision/recall, stratified FN/FP, speech/consonant preservation, suppression, peaks, alignment and authorized listening; no output, parity vector, cohort, timing or benchmark result exists.

gates.requirement: The full 40-hex source revision, detector weights, configuration, calibration and metadata SHA-256 values and the source licence match exact pins.
An isolated hash-pinned runtime with a complete lock is admitted on a recorded platform.
Source, weight, training-data, breath-recording consent, source-audio, output-use and redistribution rights are cleared with notices.
The exact breath target definition and preservation policy are approved, including expressive/linguistic turn cues and non-removable breath classes.
A rights-cleared held-out natural breath cohort scores event precision/recall and stratified false negatives/positives against known positives, negatives and adjacent speech transients.
Paired and unpaired evidence separates suppression from speech and consonant preservation, peaks, nonfinite failures, alignment and authorized listening.
Explicit opt-in provider intake, licence review, descriptor review and an independent public-surface decision are complete; the component ships optional only.
Explicit default selection, resource/deadline evidence and release or public-benchmark approval are recorded; this package is off by default.

qualification.reason: No breath detector/removal source checkout, full upstream revision, detector weights, exact target/policy geometry, hash-pinned runtime, licence, natural breath event labels, rights record, output-use grant, rights-cleared cohort, parity vector or local detection/removal output exists. The merged matrix row is a synthetic click screen that explicitly leaves natural breaths untested.

rate_profile_requirements.requirement: Measure exact source-sample to output-sample mapping, content delay and the final partial window for the intended frame path.
Measure duration, playback buffering, fill/flush and rebuffer behavior under 1x playback.
Measure pitch and transient audibility for 1x, rate changes, music and speech.
Include 1x, rate changes, unfamiliar speech, music, silence, rebuffer, drift and the final partial window.
Keep pause, filler or breath-removal decisions tied to exact source timestamps rather than a separate wall clock.
Measure speech and consonant preservation for every removal decision.
Define the breath target and preservation policy, including expressive/linguistic turn cues and non-removable classes.
Score natural breath event labels with precision, recall and stratified false negatives/positives.
Score paired removal quality and authorized listening separately where permitted references exist.
Measure memory, CPU/deadline and actual availability on the intended device.

stable_fields.acceptance: Apply the rate acceptance profile; record exact scope, evidence, failure/control results, and remaining release gates. A readiness conclusion with an exact external blocker is an accepted investigation handoff; it does not close the conditional implementation.
stable_fields.deliverable: Verify runnable source, exact assets, permitted scope, task geometry and matched evidence. Then implement or wrap a minimal reference using the relevant public adapter boundary and ship it as optional initially. Record a concrete blocker if feasibility fails.
stable_fields.title: Breath detector / removal
